propositions: CPython 3.12+ warns about fork() deadlock risk when called from a multithreaded host; the grounding harness hard-codes fork context on POSIX, triggering the warning in production.

The default worker context must switch from fork to spawn, requiring all worker callables and arguments to be importable module-level names and pickleable, with an optional caller-supplied context parameter for legacy fork compatibility.
Process construction, start, and serialization failures, as well as parent receive and unpickling failures, must return RunResult with abstain_reason rather than raise exceptions.

Existing worker lifecycle tests (timeout, exception, signal-crash, cleanup, reap-lag contracts) must remain green under the spawn default, with one spawn-incompatible test fixture replaced using a parent-only proxy.
